sections.decomposition_order: §15 Decomposition Guidance, lines 351-369 — transcribed verbatim, in order.
sections.phases: §14 Implementation Phases, lines 335-347 — 'phase', 'scope' and 'exit_gate' are the PRD table verbatim.
sections.phase_tasks: NOT declared by the PRD. §14 names no task ids. 'tasks' is a hand mapping from each phase's scope text to the shipped task files, recorded here so the check is data a reader can audit rather than logic buried in a test. Treat a failure against it as a question about the mapping, not proof the plan is wrong.

_provenance.known_divergence: §15 recommends 15 tasks. The shipped decomposition has 17: TASK-TDL-041 and TASK-TDL-042 have no §15 entry. They are recorded in 'tasks_absent_from_section_15' rather than silently added to the §15 list.
